preparationNotes: GitHub contents API failed while retrieving the binary patch; the same immutable file was retrieved successfully through the raw endpoint.
HF verified all 10 downloaded files. Missing image-preprocessing files and local cache/conversion outputs were reported separately; they are not corrupt downloaded inputs.
The converter does not store general.parameter_count. The model manifest gguf_parameter_count is the sum of stored GGUF tensor elements, not a count of unique upstream parameters.

The published 131072 touched coordinates include values rounded back to their original BF16 bits; the published manifest and source audit have 130188 actually changed BF16 entries. Q4 block quantization can change additional positions within those same two tensors.
